openings.claim: Speculatively, a provenance graph may recognize an already represented retroactive correction across changed row identifiers, preventing double application while preserving every occurrence. Dependencies become immutable row occurrences, explicit supersession edges, status meanings and cutoff eligibility; matching normalized quantities suggest aliases but never establish identity.
openings.discriminator: With uniquely establishing explicit records, the graph should reconcile the awkward amendment without double application; literal superseded-row lookup using the same occurrence-preserving ledger should retain disagreement when identifiers cannot establish representation. Removing a needed edge or introducing undefined status should withdraw affected definite conclusions. Unsupported aliases, definite quantities surviving indispensable-evidence loss, or sealed-key contradiction defeat the claim. Identical behavior leaves capability unconfirmed; no distinguishing case makes the experiment inconclusive.
openings.probe: Within sixty minutes, run both variants on both supplied copies using a local script or spreadsheet; reserve ten minutes to freeze twelve per-batch outputs with record citations. Retain duplicate and unmatched occurrences; normalize only U=5V; never impute neighboring quantities. Output a quantity or explicit disagreement naming competing records and unknowns. Issue at most three prioritized requests naming missing fields or records; preserve remaining disagreements. In the separate twenty-minute comparison, open the sealed key after freezing; compare resolved-batch counts, unsupported definite claims and request counts, examining whether disturbed records specifically change justified conclusions.
openings.uncertainty: Supplied records may lack authoritative links between differently identified replacements; quantity equality and chronology alone cannot establish them. Capacity to construct and check both variants is unproved: if they cannot fit the review budget, freeze bounded disagreements. More than three independent gaps limits follow-up coverage without permitting invented resolution. This is an enabling probe, not deployment; time caps and equal quantities do not demonstrate provenance support.

lineage.reason: Retains the speculative relation, evidence dependencies, complete rival and disturbance predictions, defeat and inconclusive conditions, bounded probe, uncertain fit, and resource caveats.

decision: Test only within supplied evidence and budgets; freeze bounded disagreement wherever support or capacity is insufficient.
